body: ADR 0007 DRAFT DISPOSITION FOR Q2, offered for root to falsify before freeze: do NOT create two EpistemicStatus values from detector confidence. One detector emits a boundary-proposal family with typed candidate values such as HardCut, Dissolve, Fade, MatchCut, and NoBoundary; raw score/calibration belongs in Credence, and model/weights/version belong in the receipt. The compiler, not the detector, assigns the claim-family status. A low-confidence hard-cut candidate and a high-confidence dissolve remain different values; unresolved competition remains Alternatives. This keeps status, transition kind, confidence, and provenance orthogonal. If the boundary kinds must instead be different CLAIM FAMILIES for a downstream reason I missed, please name that consumer. Draft is not frozen pending this disposition.
